claim.quote: ANAIS-112 data are consistent with the null hypothesis (p-values of 0.65 and 0.16 for [2-6] and [1-6] keV energy regions, respectively).

key_value_text.quote: The best fits for the modulation hypothesis are consistent with the absence of modulation ($S_m$=-0.0044$\pm$0.0058 cpd/kg/keV and -0.0015$\pm$0.0063 cpd/kg/keV, respectively).

name: First results on dark matter annual modulation from ANAIS-112 experiment

summary.plain: ANAIS-112's first look at a year and a half of data found no yearly rise and fall in its counts, as expected for no modulation, and showed the detector could reach the sensitivity needed to test DAMA/LIBRA within five years.
summary.technical: 1.5 years of data (157.55 kg yr), blind annual-modulation analysis: best-fit amplitudes S_m = -0.0044 +- 0.0058 cpd/kg/keV ([2-6] keV) and -0.0015 +- 0.0063 cpd/kg/keV ([1-6] keV); in agreement with the estimated sensitivity, supporting a 3 sigma sensitivity to DAMA/LIBRA in 5 years.

title: First results on dark matter annual modulation from ANAIS-112 experiment
why_it_matters: First annual-modulation result from a NaI(Tl) experiment designed to test DAMA/LIBRA with the same target; the abstract describes the DAMA/LIBRA result as neither confirmed nor ruled out by any other experiment in a model-independent way.
